voice ai assistant: A conversational AI system that processes voice input and provides intelligent responses using speech recognition and natural language processing.
faster whisper: An optimized implementation of OpenAI's Whisper model for fast and accurate speech recognition.
speech recognition: Technology that converts spoken language into text, enabling voice-based interactions with computer systems.
natural language processing: A field of AI that helps computers understand, interpret and generate human language in a valuable way.
fastapi: A modern, fast web framework for building APIs with Python based on standard Python type hints.
lendenclub: India's largest peer-to-peer lending platform that connects borrowers with lenders, offering personal loans, business loans, and education loans at competitive interest rates.
peer to peer lending: A method of debt financing that enables individuals to borrow and lend money without the use of an official financial institution as an intermediary.
personal loan: Unsecured loans offered by LendenClub for personal needs like medical expenses, travel, education, with amounts from ₹25,000 to ₹10,00,000 and tenure up to 60 months.
business loan: Loans for business expansion, working capital, equipment purchase with amounts from ₹1,00,000 to ₹50,00,000 and competitive interest rates.
education loan: Loans for higher education in India and abroad with amounts from ₹50,000 to ₹20,00,000 and flexible repayment options.
loan eligibility: Basic criteria include minimum age, income requirements, credit score above 650, employment stability, and proper documentation.
emi calculation: Equated Monthly Installment calculated using principal amount, interest rate, and tenure using the standard EMI formula.
credit score: A numerical representation of creditworthiness ranging from 300-900, with 650+ required for most LendenClub loans.
interest rates: LendenClub offers competitive rates starting from 10.99% for personal loans, 12.99% for business loans, and 8.99% for education loans.
loan documentation: Required documents typically include PAN card, Aadhaar card, income proof, bank statements, and employment verification.
loan processing time: Personal loans can be processed within 24-48 hours, while business loans may take 3-7 days depending on complexity.
prepayment: Borrowers can prepay loans anytime after 6 EMIs, though prepayment charges may apply as per loan agreement.
rbi guidelines: LendenClub operates under RBI guidelines for peer-to-peer lending platforms and is registered as an NBFC-P2P.
